create_annotation.description: Mark a date on every Amplitude chart with a label, so a release, an outage or a campaign shows up next to its effect on the numbers. Point it at one chart, or leave it on all of them.
create_annotation.name: create_annotation

parameters.description: The short text shown on the chart.
parameters.name: label

parameters.description: The day the annotation marks.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Leave empty for a single day, or set it to mark a period.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: Longer text shown when someone opens the annotation.
parameters.name: details

parameters.description: Name of the annotation category to file it under, such as Releases. Leave empty for none.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Id of a single chart to attach it to - the last part of the chart's URL. Leave empty to show it on every chart.
parameters.name: chart_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

delete_annotation.description: Remove a chart annotation for good. Takes the annotation's numeric id.
delete_annotation.name: delete_annotation

parameters.description: The annotation's numeric id. Use List annotations to find one.
parameters.name: annotation_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_active_users.description: Count active or new users per day, week or month, optionally broken down by a property. The headline number behind DAU, WAU and MAU.
get_active_users.name: get_active_users

parameters.description: First day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Active users or new users. Defaults to active.
parameters.name: metric

parameters.description: How finely to bucket the result over time. Defaults to daily.
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: Name of a property to split the result by, such as country or platform. Prefix a custom user property with 'gp:'. Leave empty for one combined series.
parameters.name: group_by

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_annotation.description: Read one chart annotation by its id: its label, details, dates, category and the chart it belongs to.
get_annotation.name: get_annotation

parameters.description: The annotation's numeric id. Use List annotations to find one.
parameters.name: annotation_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_average_session_length.description: Read the average length of a session, in seconds, for each day in the window. Use it to see whether a change made people stay longer.
get_average_session_length.display_str_template: Read the Amplitude average session length.
get_average_session_length.name: get_average_session_length

parameters.description: First day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: end_date

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_average_sessions_per_user.description: Read how many sessions the average user starts each day. Use it alongside session length to tell 'people come back more often' from 'people stay longer'.
get_average_sessions_per_user.name: get_average_sessions_per_user

parameters.description: First day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: end_date

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_event_segmentation.description: Count how often an event happens over time - unique users, total events, share of daily active users, or average per user - optionally broken down by a property. This is Amplitude's Event Segmentation chart as data.
get_event_segmentation.name: get_event_segmentation

parameters.description: The event to measure. Pick one of the project's events, or use [Amplitude] Any Active Event to count every event.
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.description: First day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: What to count. Defaults to unique users.
parameters.name: metric

parameters.description: Count all active users, or only users new in the window.
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.description: How finely to bucket the result over time. Defaults to daily. Amplitude will not spread real-time or hourly buckets over a long range, so picking one of those shortens the default window to 3 days (real-time) or 9 days (hourly).
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: Name of a property to split the result by, such as country or platform. Prefix a custom user property with 'gp:'. Leave empty for one combined series.
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.description: How many 'Break down by' values to return. Ignored when nothing is broken down. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: limit

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_funnel_analysis.description: Measure how many users get from one event to the next through a sequence of steps, and where they drop off. Returns the conversion rate and user count at each step, plus how long the median and average user took to get there.
get_funnel_analysis.name: get_funnel_analysis

parameters.description: The events that make up the funnel, in order. At least two. Use List events to find the exact names.
parameters.name: events

parameters.description: First day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: How strictly to require the order. Defaults to in this order.
parameters.name: mode

options.label: In this order with nothing in between

parameters.description: Count all active users, or only users new in the window.
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.description: How finely to bucket the result over time. Defaults to daily. Amplitude will not spread real-time or hourly buckets over a long range, so picking one of those shortens the default window to 3 days (real-time) or 9 days (hourly).
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: Name of a property to split the result by, such as country or platform. Prefix a custom user property with 'gp:'. Leave empty for one combined series.
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.description: How long a user has to finish the funnel. Defaults to 2592000 (30 days).
parameters.name: conversion_window_seconds

parameters.description: How many 'Break down by' values to return. Ignored when nothing is broken down. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: limit

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_realtime_active_users.description: Read how many users are active right now, minute by minute, with yesterday alongside for comparison. Takes no date range - Amplitude always reports the last two days.
get_realtime_active_users.name: get_realtime_active_users

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_retention_analysis.description: Measure how many users come back after a starting action, day by day, week by week or month by month. Defaults to new users returning for anything at all, which is the standard retention curve.
get_retention_analysis.name: get_retention_analysis

parameters.description: The action that puts a user in the cohort. Defaults to [Amplitude] New User.
parameters.name: start_event

parameters.description: What counts as coming back. Defaults to [Amplitude] Any Event.
parameters.name: return_event

parameters.description: First day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: How to decide a user was retained. Defaults to N-day.
parameters.name: retention_mode

options.label: N-day (came back on exactly that day)
Rolling (came back on that day or later)
N-day or before (came back by that day)

parameters.description: Only for bracket mode: the day ranges to group returns into, such as [[0,4],[4,8]].
parameters.name: brackets

parameters.description: How finely to bucket the result over time. Defaults to daily.
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: Name of a property to split the result by, such as country or platform. Prefix a custom user property with 'gp:'. Leave empty for one combined series.
parameters.name: group_by

start_event.description: The action that defined the cohort

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_revenue_ltv.description: Read revenue per user over their lifetime: average revenue per user, per paying user, total revenue, or the number of paying users. Needs revenue on your events to return anything.
get_revenue_ltv.name: get_revenue_ltv

parameters.description: First day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Which revenue figure to read. Defaults to ARPU.
parameters.name: metric

options.label: ARPPU - average revenue per paying user

parameters.description: How finely to bucket the result over time. Defaults to daily.
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: Name of a property to split the result by, such as country or platform. Prefix a custom user property with 'gp:'. Leave empty for one combined series.
parameters.name: group_by

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_session_length_distribution.description: Read how session lengths are spread across buckets - how many sessions lasted 0-60 seconds, 60-120, and so on. Set the bucket unit and size, or leave them empty for Amplitude's own.
get_session_length_distribution.display_str_template: Read the Amplitude session length distribution.
get_session_length_distribution.name: get_session_length_distribution

parameters.description: First day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: What unit the buckets are measured in.
parameters.name: bin_time_unit

parameters.description: Where the buckets start, in the unit above.
parameters.name: bin_min

parameters.description: Where the buckets stop, in the unit above.
parameters.name: bin_max

parameters.description: How wide each bucket is, in the unit above.
parameters.name: bin_size

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_user_composition.description: See how the user base splits across one property - which countries, which platforms, which app versions - with a count for each value in the window.
get_user_composition.name: get_user_composition

parameters.description: Which user property to break the user base down by. Pick a built-in, or type a custom user property as 'gp:your_property'.
parameters.name: user_property

parameters.description: First day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Leave both dates empty to read the last 30 days.
parameters.name: end_date

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

user_property.description: The property the users were split by

list_annotations.description: List the project's chart annotations, optionally narrowed to one category, one chart, or a date range.
list_annotations.name: list_annotations

parameters.description: Only annotations filed under this category name.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Only annotations attached to this chart id.
parameters.name: chart_id

parameters.description: First day to include. Give both dates or neither; leave both empty for all of them.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Last day to include. Give both dates or neither; leave both empty for all of them.
parameters.name: end_date

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_events.description: List every event type in the project, with how many times each has been seen and whether it is hidden or deleted. This is where to find the exact spelling the query actions want.
list_events.name: list_events

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

search_users.description: Find a user in Amplitude by their Amplitude ID, Device ID, User ID, or the start of a User ID. Returns every match with its Amplitude ID. No match is an empty list, not an error.
search_users.name: search_users

parameters.description: An Amplitude ID, Device ID, User ID, or the first part of a User ID.
parameters.name: user

match_type.description: Which kind of id Amplitude matched on

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

send_event.description: Record one event in Amplitude for a user or a device, with any event and user properties you want attached, and optionally the revenue it represents. Use this to get whatever a workflow does into your product analytics.
send_event.name: send_event

parameters.description: What happened, as you want it to appear in Amplitude - for example 'Invoice Paid'. A new name creates a new event type.
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.description: Your own id for this person, at least 5 characters - Amplitude rejects shorter ones. Give this or a Device ID.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Id of the device the event came from, at least 5 characters. Give this or a User ID.
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.description: Details of this occurrence, as name/value pairs.
parameters.name: event_properties

parameters.description: Properties to set on the user at the same time, as name/value pairs.
parameters.name: user_properties

parameters.description: When the event happened. Leave empty to use the moment Amplitude receives it.
parameters.name: time

parameters.description: A unique id for this event. Amplitude ignores a repeat of the same key within 7 days, which makes a retried step safe.
parameters.name: insert_id

parameters.description: Where the event came from, such as Web or iOS.
parameters.name: platform

parameters.description: Version of your app that produced the event.
parameters.name: app_version

parameters.description: Country to attribute the event to.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: City to attribute the event to.
parameters.name: city

parameters.description: Revenue this event represents. Amplitude uses price times quantity when this is empty.
parameters.name: revenue

parameters.description: Price of one unit sold.
parameters.name: price

parameters.description: How many units were sold.
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.description: Identifier of the product involved.
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: How to classify it, such as purchase or refund.
parameters.name: revenue_type

events_ingested.description: How many events Amplitude stored (1 on success)

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

send_events.description: Record many events at once, up to 2,000 in one call. Each entry is a full event object - the same fields as Send event. Use this to backfill a batch of activity a step has just produced instead of sending them one at a time.
send_events.display_str_template: Send a batch of events to Amplitude.
send_events.name: send_events

parameters.description: The events to send. Each needs an 'event_type' and either a 'user_id' or a 'device_id'.
parameters.name: events

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

set_user_properties.description: Update what Amplitude knows about a person without recording an event: set properties, set them only if they are not already there, add to a number, or clear them. Use it to keep plan, role or lifecycle stage current on the user.
set_user_properties.name: set_user_properties

parameters.description: Your own id for this person, at least 5 characters - Amplitude rejects shorter ones. Give this or a Device ID.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Id of the device the event came from, at least 5 characters. Give this or a User ID.
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.description: Properties to set, overwriting whatever is there.
parameters.name: set_properties

parameters.description: Properties to set only the first time, such as the date someone signed up.
parameters.name: set_once_properties

parameters.description: Numeric properties to increment by the given amount. Use a negative number to decrement.
parameters.name: add_properties

parameters.description: Names of properties to remove from the user.
parameters.name: unset_properties

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

update_annotation.description: Change an existing chart annotation - its label, details, dates, category or chart. Anything left empty stays as it is.
update_annotation.name: update_annotation

parameters.description: The annotation's numeric id. Use List annotations to find one.
parameters.name: annotation_id

parameters.description: New label. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
parameters.name: label

parameters.description: New date. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: New end date. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: New details. Leave empty to keep them as they are.
parameters.name: details

parameters.description: New category name. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: New chart id. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
parameters.name: chart_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

description: Send events and user properties to Amplitude, query your product metrics, and annotate the charts.
